knowledge_points.title: Present Perfect Tense (现在完成时)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：have/has + 过去分词。用法：1.表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果；2.表示过去开始的动作持续到现在。常与already, yet, just, ever, never, for+段时间, since+点时间连用。

knowledge_points.title: Reading Strategies
knowledge_points.content: Skimming(略读) for main idea; Scanning(查读) for specific information; Predicting(预测) before reading.

exam_points.name: 现在完成时与一般过去时的区别
exam_points.content: 现在完成时强调与现在的联系，一般过去时只表示过去发生的事。

test_questions.content: —______ you ______ your homework yet? —Yes, I ______ it an hour ago.
test_questions.explanation: 第一空yet常与现在完成时连用，第二空an hour ago是一般过去时，故选B。

knowledge_points.title: Modal Verbs (情态动词)
knowledge_points.content: can/could表示能力和请求；must表示必须和肯定推测；should表示建议和责备；may/might表示许可和可能。must的疑问句否定回答用needn't。

exam_points.name: 情态动词的用法
exam_points.content: 考查情态动词表推测、责备等用法。

test_questions.content: You ______ be tired after such a long journey. Let me help you with your luggage.
test_questions.explanation: must表示肯定的推测，意为“一定”，故选B。

knowledge_points.title: Past Perfect Tense (过去完成时)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：had + 过去分词。用法：表示在过去某一时间或动作之前已经发生或完成的动作，即“过去的过去”。常与by the time, before, when等连用。

exam_points.name: 过去完成时
exam_points.content: 考查过去完成时与一般过去时的区别。

test_questions.content: By the time he arrived at the station, the train ______.
test_questions.explanation: 火车离开发生在他到达之前，是“过去的过去”，用过去完成时，故选C。
test_questions.source: 2023年华东师大二附中高一期末考试

chapters.name: Unit 1 The World of Our Senses

knowledge_points.title: Noun Clauses (名词性从句)
knowledge_points.content: 包括主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句、同位语从句。引导词：that, whether, if, who, what, which, when, where, why, how。注意：that在名词性从句中不充当成分，what充当主语、宾语或表语。

exam_points.name: 名词性从句
exam_points.content: 考查引导词的选择和语序。

test_questions.content: ______ made the school proud was ______ more than 90% of the students had been admitted to key universities.
test_questions.explanation: 第一空what引导主语从句并在从句中作主语；第二空that引导表语从句，不充当成分，故选B。
test_questions.source: 2023年上海交大附中高一期末考试

knowledge_points.title: Passive Voice (被动语态)
knowledge_points.content: 构成：be + 过去分词。常用时态：一般现在时am/is/are done；一般过去时was/were done；现在完成时have/has been done；带情态动词must be done。

exam_points.name: 被动语态
exam_points.content: 考查各种时态的被动语态。

test_questions.content: The new library ______ next month will be the biggest one in our city.
test_questions.explanation: next month表将来，用不定式的被动式作后置定语，故选D。

knowledge_points.title: Inversion (倒装句)
knowledge_points.content: 完全倒装：副词/介词短语+谓语+主语。部分倒装：否定词(hardly, never, seldom, little等)置于句首时，助动词/情态动词/be动词提前。Only+状语置于句首也用部分倒装。

exam_points.name: 倒装句
exam_points.content: 考查部分倒装和完全倒装的应用。

test_questions.content: ______ had I arrived at the station when the train started to move.
test_questions.explanation: Hardly...when...为固定句型，意为“一...就...”，hardly置于句首用部分倒装，故选B。
